profile.reasoning: Sana Castillo is a 32-year-old content creator and tech operator focused on the intersection of AI and sustainable fashion. She spent the first part of her career as a software engineer, specializing in computer vision, before realizing the power of content to drive broader adoption of technology. A pivotal moment was building a real-time style recommendation engine for a fast fashion company, which exposed her to the industry’s wastefulness and sparked her passion for sustainability. Now, she's building 'ThreadAI,' a platform using AI to personalize sustainable fashion choices, predict trends in eco-friendly materials, and connect conscious consumers with ethical brands. She’s actively seeking investors and strategic partnerships to scale ThreadAI and wants to build a community around responsible fashion tech.
profile.positioning: Sana Castillo is a technologist and content creator dedicated to revolutionizing the fashion industry through artificial intelligence. With a background in computer vision and software engineering, she now focuses on building innovative solutions for sustainable fashion. She is the founder of ThreadAI, a platform designed to empower consumers to make conscious choices and connect with ethical brands. Sana’s work blends technical expertise with compelling storytelling, fostering a community around responsible consumption and driving positive change within the industry. She’s passionate about using technology to minimize fashion’s environmental impact and create a more circular economy.
